clusters.label: Library Wi-Fi drops in the afternoon

complaints.transcript: The Wi-Fi in the library keeps dropping every afternoon and nobody seems to fix it.
Can't load anything on the library network after lunch.
Library internet dies right when everyone is studying for exams.
The canteen line takes 25 minutes and our break is only 40.
Only one billing counter is open at lunch, it's chaos.
The projector in 204 has been flickering for a week.
